outcomes.notes: Unknown run_id returns empty trace list without crashing.
Malformed trace.jsonl raises JSONDecodeError. This is acceptable but could be hardened to return empty list with logged warning instead of propagating raw exception.

outcomes.notes: Corrupted existing trace raises JSONDecodeError. Same hardening opportunity as malformed trace.

notes: Trace failure modes are safe (do not expose secrets or cause undefined behavior), but raw JSONDecodeError propagates from TraceStore on malformed lines. A future front could add defensive parsing in TraceStore to return an empty/warning trace. No source code modified.
